# Pulse task #2676: W07: Extend shared native widgets for sample, modulation, rack and analysis editors

Operation: 0f6ba357abfdd03597dc4930f17258c8
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

Part of Hex native device roadmap #2661, goal 3, version 0.1. Astra assessment: 17 October 2026.

Goal: all device interfaces use a coherent, accessible shared toolkit, including advanced editors.

Deliverables:
- Inventory missing reusable controls against W01: waveform/range/loop/slice editor; sample key/velocity zones; XY pad; modulation matrix and routing/algorithm diagram; rack chain/zone/pad grid and macros; breakpoint/envelope curve editors; scrolling spectral/spectrogram views; calibrated meter/tuner/time displays.
- Extend existing ResponseGraph/BarEditor/curve/meter/frame/selector primitives where appropriate. New widgets receive normalized display data, style and semantic IDs; emit generic gestures; own no DSP, codecs, project edits, files or audio queues.
- Keep bounded cached geometry/decimation, visible-content rendering, reusable densities, native focus and pointer capture. Keyboard alternatives, text precision, screen-reader semantics, labels/values/states and disabled availability are real contracts.
- Compose responsive fixed-rail and expanded editors without clipping at minimum supported window sizes or scale factors. Preserve injected application theme, Ioskeley Mono and lowercase app text.
- Extend the production gallery with representative full panels, real hit testing, focus order and constrained-layout cases. Coordinate #29's accessibility/dense UI work rather than fork it.

Acceptance: each widget ships with at least one production consumer and rendered interaction coverage; dragging outside, Escape/blur, entity removal, Undo and unsupported capability behavior are verified. Native user checklist covers visual density, keyboard/screen reader and input feel; headless scene geometry is not mislabeled pixel/native acceptance.

Sources: hex-widgets public API/frame/numeric/response_graph/bar_editor; hex-ui/device_composition.rs; docs/device-controls.md; #2355/#2474 gallery work.

Planning workstream: split implementation into focused PRs as work begins. Related canonical tickets: #29, #2355, #2474, #2654. Preserve their current scope, versions, status and PR history. Dependency edges order the enabling contracts; downstream production proof is qualified incrementally under W20.
